sloka: एवम् ब्रुवाणौ काकुत्स्थौ त्वरमाणौ युयुत्सया ।सर्वे ते मुनयः प्रीताः प्रशशंसुर् नृपात्मजौ ॥१-३०-३॥
transliteration: evam bruvāṇau kākutsthau tvaramāṇau yuyutsayā ।sarve te munayaḥ prītāḥ praśaśaṁsur nṛpātmajau ॥1-30-3॥

translations.english: The sages (of the asrama) were very pleased. They extolled the princes of Kakustha dynasty, who were eager to fight the rakshasas.
